architecture.intervention: Perform an on-orbit thermal cycling test by commanding the reaction wheel to spin up while the spacecraft is in eclipse (low temperature) versus sunlit (high temperature) to isolate the thermal coupling of the bearing stall.
architecture.expected_effect: The intermittent stall will reproduce exclusively during the cold thermal cycle, confirming that the failure mode is coupled to temperature-induced viscosity changes or thermal contraction in the bearing assembly.
architecture.falsification_test: If the bearing stall occurs simultaneously during both high-temperature (sunlit) and low-temperature (eclipse) periods at the same rotational speed, the thermal coupling hypothesis is falsified.
